description: This file defines the ListPlugin class for CKEditor 5 integration within Drupal, providing configuration and behavior for list handling in the editor.

classes.name: ListPlugin
classes.description: A plugin class for CKEditor 5 that manages list features, including configuration, form building, validation, and dynamic configuration generation.

methods.name: defaultConfiguration
methods.description: Returns the default configuration array for the list plugin, including properties like reversed, startIndex, styles, and multiBlock.

methods.name: buildConfigurationForm
methods.description: Builds the configuration form for the plugin, allowing users to set options like reversed, start index, styles, and multiBlock.

methods.name: validateConfigurationForm
methods.description: Validates and casts form input values to boolean for plugin configuration.

methods.name: submitConfigurationForm
methods.description: Saves form input values into the plugin's configuration.

methods.name: getDynamicPluginConfig
methods.description: Generates and returns the dynamic plugin configuration array based on current settings.

methods.name: getElementsSubset
methods.description: Returns a subset of list elements based on configuration, including handling of list styles and reversed/start attributes.
